title: Masu Cin Amana na Zaɓaɓɓu
intro: A cikin tarihi, manzannin allahntaka suna tafiya a tsakanin bil'adama, kuma wasu daga cikin mafi kusanci da su sun kasa gane hasken. Wannan labarin ya ta'allaka ne a kan rayuka biyu waɗanda kusancinsu da annabci ya zama jarabawarsu, kuma gadonsu darasi ne mara iyaka.
clues: Mun rayu ne a zamanin manyan annabawa, duk da haka idanunmu sun kasance a rufe ga gaskiyar da suka kawo.
Gidajenmu sun cika da wahayin Allah, amma zukatanmu sun taurare.
Mun auri maza waɗanda aka zaɓa don su yi wa mutanensu gargaɗi.
Lokacin da hukunci ya zo, ba mu nemi mafaka a cikin jirgin ba kuma ba mu gudu daga ruwan sama mai zafi ba, domin mun yi ba'a ga gargaɗin.
An ambace mu a cikin Alqur'ani a matsayin misali ga waɗanda suka kafirta, yana nuna cewa ko da kusanci da annabi ba ya ceton.
Mu ne matan Nuhu da Lutu, waɗanda suka ci amanarsu, don haka aka la'ance su.

identity.label: Su waye Mu?
options: Matan Nuhu da Lutu
Matan Ibrahim da Isma'il
Matan Musa da Haruna
Matan Dawud da Sulaiman
Matan Ayyub da Yunus

trial.label: Menene shari'arsu?
options: An auri annabawa amma sun kafirta
Ba su da haihuwa kuma sun zargi annabawa
Sun kasance masu arziki da girman kai
Iblis ya jarabce su da su bar gidajensu.
Sun bauta wa Ɗan Maraƙin Zinare
trial.answer: An auri annabawa amma sun kafirta

location.label: Me aka haɗa da ƙaddararsu?
options: Ambaliyar ruwa da ruwan sama na duwatsu
Iska mai ƙarfi
Girgizar ƙasa
Annobar fari
Rabe-raben teku
location.answer: Ambaliyar ruwa da ruwan sama na duwatsu

outcome.label: Menene ƙarshensu?
options: Sun halaka tare da kafirai
Sun tuba kuma aka cece su
An bar su ba tare da ɗa ba
An yi musu hijira har abada
An mayar da su birai da aladu

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
